title: SAIB: Buriza.Browser - A Dedicated Built-in Browser for the Buriza Wallet

ms.promise:
Design the user interface and experience for Buriza.Browser, tailored specifically for a browser extension workflow. 
The design will focus on seamless integration of wallet functionalities into the browser, providing intuitive access to Cardano dApps, and transaction management. 
The design will also accommodate users configuring their own backend servers and interacting with decentralized applications directly. 
1. Wireframes and mockups for extension screens will be provided for the following features: 
・Sending assets: Form for entering recipient address, asset type, and amount 
・Receiving assets: Any received assets will reflect and display in the wallet balance and asset list once the transaction is confirmed on the blockchain 
・Viewing balance and assets: Shows an overview of the wallet's current balance, list of assets held, and their respective values 
・Transaction history: List of past transactions, filtered or sorted by date, asset type, or transaction status for the specific wallet address 
・Full node setup: Step-by-step process for configuring a backend server or full node 
・dApp access: Embedded interface for connecting with other Cardano decentralized applications
ms.criteria:
1. Reviewer must be able to check the Figma link of the design file and verify that the design contains the wireframes and mockups for screens: 
・Sending assets 
・Receiving assets 
・Viewing balance and assets 
・Transaction history 
・Full node setup 
・dApp access 
・ A reviewer can see that the design does indeed focus on: 
・Browser extension workflow
・Intuitive access to Cardano dApps
・Transaction Management

2. Reviewer must be able to check that the linked report covers: 
・Design decisions 
・Usability considerations 
・Browser extension-specific accessibility features.

ms.promise:
Develop the Buriza.Browser extension as per the UI/UX design. This includes building the browser extension’s front-end for key wallet interactions. 
The implementation will focus on the unique needs of a browser extension, ensuring it functions securely and efficiently within the browser environment while allowing users to configure backend settings and interact with decentralized applications seamlessly. 
1. Source code for front-end components of the browser extension. 
・Integration of wallet features, such as: 
・Sending assets 
・Receiving assets 
・Viewing balance and assets 
・Transaction history 
・Full node setup 
・dApp access 

2. Report outlining the progress of the implementation and challenges encountered during the development of the browser extension.
ms.criteria:
1. A reviewer must be able to verify that the source code for the design implementation is available and has integrated the wallet features. 
・A reviewer must be able to run the source code and interact with the design hands on. 

2. A reviewer must be able to view the report that outlines the design implementation details.
